issues.summary: Wet damage found on 14 cartons of diagnostic reagent kits in container OCLU6145131 at delivery under HBL MFCIM260017 / MBL OCLU260629, with claim expected to exceed USD 10,000.

decisions.summary: Grace Yoon decided to appoint an independent surveyor, pursue the wet damage claim against Orient Container Line, and send weekly claim updates to the consignee until closure.
Jiwoo Han handed over the claim file for HBL MFCIM260017 to Daniel Cho ahead of leaving on 30 June.

tasks.summary: Collect the surveyor report and submit the formal claim to Orient Container Line for MBL OCLU260629 / container OCLU6145131.
Continue weekly claim updates to Insoo Hwang at Seoul Medica Supplies until the claim is closed.
Arrange an independent surveyor to inspect the 14 damaged cartons.

deadlines.what: Submit formal claim with surveyor report to Orient Container Line
